summary: Verified the receipt-print fix by programmatically generating and dissecting the actual jsPDF output (node harness that mirrors buildReceiptPdf + pypdf/pdftoppm inspection of a PDF really downloaded from the preview app). CONFIRMED GOOD: page is 80mm wide (MediaBox 226.77pt) single page, amount renders at 72pt when it fits (adaptive: 52pt for Rs 12,500 with wide glyphs, 32pt for 1,25,00,000), detail labels are 18pt and values 20-30pt (vs previous 7/10pt), Download and Share produce byte-identical PDFs (5178 bytes both), receipt number 18pt courier and all detail fields present. CONFIRMED BROKEN: (1) pdf.internal.pageSize.setHeight() is called AFTER all drawing, so every element keeps the coordinates computed against the original 240mm page -> content is vertically offset by (240 - finalHeight)mm. Rasterised proof: on the app-downloaded receipt (227mm page) the dark brand bar + 'CO. DAILY COLLECTION' + 'DIGITAL PAYMENT RECEIPT' are cut off the TOP (title baseline at 640.6pt vs page height 643.5pt) with ~25mm blank at the bottom; on a short receipt (209mm page) the whole header block is gone; on a long receipt with remarks (260mm page) the dashed rule and 'Thank you for your payment.' fall BELOW the page (baseline at -28pt) and are not printed at all. (2) The brand title at 24pt is 99mm wide on an 80mm page (x starts at -28.5pt) so it is clipped on both sides. (3) The rupee sign is not renderable in jsPDF standard Helvetica (WinAnsi): the amount is emitted as ' \xb9\x005\x000\x000' and prints as a superscript '1' followed by the digits - the most important number on the receipt shows a wrong currency glyph. Backend/auth: Ananya (+91 98765 42101) returns 401 before AND after a supervisor backend restart, emp-ananya absent from db.employees/db.users and from GET /api/employees; duplicate col-1..col-6 collections are gone. Mobile 390px admin directory no longer overflows (17 cards, 0 overflowing, 0 clipped action buttons, doc scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390) and name/meta now wrap on separate lines. Pytest: 69 tests, 68 passed; the single failure was a stale credential in test_deployment_config (Raj's user doc was re-seeded with the temp password) which I updated in-scope.

minor.issue: Two historical rows still carry employee_name 'Ananya Shah' (seeded col-3/col-4), so the string 'Ananya' is still visible in the admin collections feed / activity history even though the employee is deleted. Expected for immutable history, but flag if the user meant a full purge.

Preview DB is full of leftover test data: 9 vendors of which 8 are TEST_*/test_case_* with address 'Pending update', and 3 of 5 employees are TEST_AuthEmp/TEST_OtherEmp. Metric card shows 'Field employees 8' while GET /api/employees returned 5 during the same session (count drifts as test employees are created/deleted) - worth confirming the metric source.

emp-raj's user doc was re-created by seed with must_change_password=true and temp password Welcome@123, silently invalidating the documented RajSecure@2026 password. Seed re-creating a user for an existing employee whose credentials were already rotated can resurrect a temporary password - consider only creating the user when the employee doc is newly inserted.

ui_bugs.issue: pdf.internal.pageSize.setHeight(Math.max(145, y + 26)) runs after all text is drawn. jsPDF converts y to PDF space using the page height active at draw time (240mm), so resizing the page afterwards shifts the entire layout. Result: header (dark bar + brand + subtitle) clipped off the top when the final height < 240mm (short receipts lose it completely at 209mm), and the dashed rule + 'Thank you for your payment.' clipped off the bottom when the final height > 240mm (baseline computed at -28pt on a 260mm page). Fix: measure first, then create the document with the final [80, H] format (or use a fixed height and draw a second measured pass).

'CO. DAILY COLLECTION' at 24pt measures 99.06mm on an 80mm page (drawn from x=-28.5pt), so it is clipped on both left and right in every generated receipt. Needs fitText()/wrapping (approx <=16pt or two lines) like the amount.

currency() emits the Unicode rupee sign U+20B9 which does not exist in jsPDF's standard Helvetica/WinAnsiEncoding. The content stream contains ' \xb9\x005\x000\x000' and the raster shows a superscript '1' instead of Rs. Use 'Rs. ' + number for the PDF or embed a Unicode font (addFont/addFileToVFS).

Wrapped values use a hard 11mm step per extra line while jsPDF's default line height for a 30pt value is ~12.2mm, and the next label starts only 18mm below the previous label baseline. With a 30pt value that wraps, lines and the following label can collide. Also the label sits only 7mm above the (up to 30pt) value, which reads as cramped in the raster.

For larger amounts the adaptive size drops well below the requested ~72pt (52pt for Rs 12,500, 32pt for Rs 1,25,00,000) because fitText is constrained to contentWidth = 68mm. Still ~3x the old size, but if the user's real receipts are lakh-scale consider using the full 80mm width minus 2-3mm for the amount only.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking opens a new tab (window.open of the blob URL) but the tab URL stayed empty in headless Chromium, so automatic printing could not be verified. Additionally printWindow.addEventListener('load', ...) is unreliable for a cross-document PDF-viewer navigation and window.open can be popup-blocked; there is no fallback/message if printWindow is null. Manual verification needed on a real browser.
No defect: both produce the same 5178-byte PDF for the same receipt (share falls back to download when navigator.share is unavailable).

issues: Short receipts print with the brand header missing and ~50mm of blank paper wasted at the bottom (offset bug).
Long receipts print without the closing dashed rule and thank-you line.
Amount shows a superscript '1' where the rupee symbol should be.
Previous overflow is FIXED - no card or action button now extends past the 390px viewport and the name/meta lines are separated.

action_items: CRITICAL: stop mutating pageSize after drawing in buildReceiptPdf - compute the required height first (measure wrapped detail lines / amount size in a throwaway doc or a two-pass render) and construct the jsPDF with format: [80, finalHeight]; then re-run `node /app/frontend/receipt_pdf_check.cjs` (all 7 assertions per scenario must pass).
Shrink/wrap the 'CO. DAILY COLLECTION' PDF header so it fits the 68mm content width (currently 99mm at 24pt, clipped on both sides).
Replace the Intl rupee glyph in the PDF amount with 'Rs.' or embed a Unicode font - it currently prints as a superscript '1'.
Use jsPDF's real line height (getLineHeight / fontSize * 1.15) for wrapped detail values instead of the hard 11mm/18mm steps.
Manually verify 'Print this receipt only' in a real browser (headless cannot load blob PDFs) and handle printWindow === null (popup blocked).
Optional: prune leftover TEST_* vendors/employees from the preview DB and reconcile the 'Field employees' metric with GET /api/employees.
critical_code_review_comments: ReceiptDialog.jsx L73: `pdf.internal.pageSize.setHeight(...)` after drawing is the root cause of the clipped header/footer - jsPDF caches no transform, y coordinates are converted to PDF space at draw time using the then-current page height, so resizing translates the whole page content.

fitText() has a floor of 20pt but no post-check: for detail values it relies on splitTextToSize wrapping, which is fine, but the vertical advance (11mm) is smaller than the actual line height at 22-30pt, so wrapped 30pt values can overlap the following label.
jsPDF standard 14 fonts are WinAnsi-only; any Intl currency/locale output containing U+20B9 will silently corrupt. Centralise a pdfCurrency() helper instead of reusing the UI currency() formatter.

printReceipt() ignores a blocked popup (printWindow null) and relies on the window 'load' event of a PDF-viewer document; add a user-visible fallback (e.g. trigger download) when printing cannot be initiated.

rca_of_the_issue: jsPDF stores text with PDF user-space coordinates computed at draw time as (pageHeight - y). buildReceiptPdf creates the document with format [80, 240], draws the whole receipt, and only then calls pdf.internal.pageSize.setHeight(max(145, y+26)), which rewrites the MediaBox without re-transforming the already-written content stream. Every element therefore ends up offset by (240 - finalHeight) mm: with the app receipt (final 227mm) the brand bar/title/subtitle sit above the page top (title baseline 640.6pt > 643.5pt page height minus glyph height) and ~25mm of paper is blank at the bottom; with a short no-remarks receipt (final 209mm) the entire header is off-page; with a remarks-heavy receipt (final 260mm) the dashed rule and thank-you line land at negative y and are dropped. Independently, the 24pt brand title measures 99.06mm > 80mm page width so it is clipped horizontally in all cases, and Intl's U+20B9 rupee sign is not present in jsPDF's WinAnsi standard Helvetica so the amount prints a superscript '1' instead of the currency symbol.
